title: Update audit rules for recorded lore and failed tool calls
description:
Update mechanics/world audit semantics for improvised lore promotion.

The auditor should accept factual assertions when supported by successful canonical evidence, including current-turn campaign-overlay recording. It must not treat failed tool calls as evidence.

Acceptance criteria:
- Failed tool calls with ok:false never support factual assertions.
- A successful record_world_fact/record_lore call in the same turn can support use of that newly introduced consequential fact.
- A successful world_query result can support assertions from module canon, campaign state, or campaign overlay lore.
- A recorded rumor supports "NPCs say/believe/report X" but does not support "X is true" unless truthStatus supports truth.
- The audit distinguishes:
  - established fact
  - attributed rumor/belief
  - scene-local continuity
  - unsupported invention
- Retry guidance tells the DM:
  - do not rely on failed world_query results
  - if introducing a consequential new detail, record it before treating it as established
  - if not recording it, phrase it as tentative/color or keep it non-consequential
- Regression tests cover the Hearthmere / Old Renn pattern:
  - first turn records missing-cart rumors/evidence
  - later turn can discuss them via world_query without rejection
close_reason: Implemented campaign overlay canon, truth-statused lore recording, world_query retrieval/search, audit/prompt guidance, docs, and regression coverage.
